title: Add Tormach PathPilot part-in-spindle mill-turning post

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Turning on a Tormach 770MX with the part in the mill spindle runs PathPilot in Mill mode, not Lathe mode (`UM10587` Ch. 10; LinuxCNC G-code reference). Mill mode uses linear radius coordinates (no `G7`), applies one `G43 H` length offset for the stock with no `M6`, and selects each table tool with its own work offset (`G54`..`G59`, `G59.1`..`G59.3`).

Add a dedicated post script (`assets/posts/tormach-mill-turn-spindle.cps`) and post routing rules (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `crates/app/src/posting_serves.rs`, `crates/app/src/lathe_voice.rs`):

- Declare a dedicated manifest flag (for example `partInSpindle = true`) so only a part-in-spindle post can post a part-in-spindle setup.
- Refuse plain milling posts and `G7` lathe posts on a part-in-spindle setup by name.
- Write `G20`/`G21`, `G18` (XZ plane), `G90`, `G91.1`, `G94`, `G40`, `G49`, `G80`, and `G64 P` in the header, with no `G7`.
- Emit `G53 G0 Z<safe_retract>` and a single `G43 H<stock>` once at program start. Never emit `M6` or `G49` between stations.
- Map turning `(r, z)` in radius mode (`1:1`, not doubled) to mill coordinates: keep `Z` unchanged, use `X = +r` for `-X` stations, and use `X = -r` with negated `I` and swapped `G2`/`G3` for `+X` stations.
- Apply nose control-point conversion (`crates/app/src/posting_nose.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/nose_tip.rs`) before station mirroring.
- Switch to each station's work offset only while Z stands at `G53 G0 Z<safe_retract>`, rapid `X` and `Y0` at that height, start the spindle (`S.. M3` or `M4` with belt-range and reverse-spindle notes), then lower Z to the clearance plane.
- Post fixed RPM (`G97` / `S.. M3/M4`) and feed per minute (`G94`) by default. Refuse `G96`, `G95`, and threading cycles until encoder-gated support lands.

Done means: golden `.nc` tests verify multi-tool facing, OD turning, grooving, parting, and on-centre drilling on `-X` and `+X` stations with exact `G18` `G2`/`G3` arc sense, one `G43 H`, zero `M6` blocks, and `G53 G0 Z` retracts between stations, and gate tests confirm that plain mill and `G7` lathe posts are refused on part-in-spindle setups.

Part of #2580
